WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCT_MIN_BALANCE)),0) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT)),0) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CAP_FREQ_START_DD)),0) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CHRG_FREQ_START_DD)),0) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ENTITY_CAP_AMT)),0) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES)),0) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),MATURITY_PERD_DAYS)),0) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),MATURITY_PERD_MTHS)),0) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM)),0) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PRENOTIFICATION_PERD)),0) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TS_CNT)),0) TS_CNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT)),0) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS)),0) NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS)),0) NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS)),0) NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS)),0) NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_WD_DAYS)),0) NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_WD_MTHS)),0) NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS)),0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS)),0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS)),0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS)),0) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
  
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_CASAMASTER WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT CONVERT(numeric(25,5),REPLACE(H,'F-','')) COUNT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),ACCT_MIN_BALANCE) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),CAP_FREQ_START_DD) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),CHRG_FREQ_START_DD) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),ENTITY_CAP_AMT) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),MATURITY_PERD_DAYS) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),MATURITY_PERD_MTHS) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),PRENOTIFICATION_PERD) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),TS_CNT) TS_CNT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS) NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS) NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS) NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS) NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_WD_DAYS) NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_WD_MTHS) NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS) NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_CASAMASTER WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
, ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
, CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
, CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
, ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
, LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
, MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
, MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
, MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
, PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
, UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
, ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
, ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
, CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
, CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
, ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
, LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
, MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
, MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
, MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
, PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
, TS_CNT_src
, UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5))COUNT_SRC, 
CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5))COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
,CAST(ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
,CAST(CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
,CAST(ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
,CAST(LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
,CAST(MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
,CAST(MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
,CAST(PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
,CAST(TS_CNT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_tgt
,CAST(UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
,CAST(ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
,CAST(ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
,CAST(CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
,CAST(CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
,CAST(ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
,CAST(LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
,CAST(MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
,CAST(MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
,CAST(MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
,CAST(PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
,CAST(TS_CNT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_src
,CAST(UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
,CAST(NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5))NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_src
, ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
, CAP_FREQ_START_DD_src
, CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_src
, ENTITY_CAP_AMT_src
, LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_src
, MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_src
, MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_src
, MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_src
, PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_src
, TS_CNT_src
, UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_src
,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_src
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, ACCT_MIN_BALANCE_tgt
, ACTIVE_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
, CAP_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
, CHRG_FREQ_START_DD_tgt
, ENTITY_CAP_AMT_tgt
, LF_CHRG_PEND_LINES_tgt
, MATURITY_PERD_DAYS_tgt
, MATURITY_PERD_MTHS_tgt
, MAX_ALWD_ADVN_LIM_tgt
, PRENOTIFICATION_PERD_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
, UTILIZED_DAYLIGHT_LIMIT_tgt
,NS_PERD_CLS_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_CLS_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_GRACE_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_GRACE_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_WD_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_WD_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_CLS_MTHS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_DAYS_tgt
,NS_PERD_XFER_OUT_MTHS_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
